text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock A after gains felt satisfying, but I should base sales on my target allocation and risk—not on the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I added to several holdings after prices fell, but a lower price alone is not evidence of value; I should decide in advance how much risk and cash to allocate rather than automatically averaging down.","My account’s decline reminded me that gains in some periods do not prevent losses later. I should keep a diversified plan and review whether my overall exposure still fits my goals."]}
